mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrowrec (sno, barCode, borDate, retDate, retStatus, fineStatus) VALUES (#{sno}, #{barCode}, #{borDate}, #{retDate}, #{retStatus}, #{fineStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT serNum, sno, barCode, borDate, retDate, realRetDate, retStatus, ovdDays, fineMoney, fineStatus, paySerNum FROM borrowrec WHERE barCode = #{barCode} AND retStatus = '未归还' LIMIT 1
SELECT serNum, sno, barCode, borDate, retDate, realRetDate, retStatus, ovdDays, fineMoney, fineStatus, paySerNum FROM borrowrec WHERE serNum = #{serNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrowrec WHERE sno = #{sno} AND retStatus = '未归还'

SELECT br.serNum AS recNo, br.barCode, b.bname AS bookName, b.author, b.ISBN, br.borDate, br.retDate, 1 AS status, GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), br.retDate), 0) AS overdueDays, COALESCE(b.price, 50.00) AS bookPrice FROM borrowrec br JOIN bookcopy bc ON br.barCode = bc.barCode JOIN book b ON bc.ISBN = b.ISBN WHERE br.sno = #{sno} AND br.retStatus = '未归还' ORDER BY br.borDate DESC

SELECT br.serNum AS recNo, br.barCode, b.bname AS bookName, b.author, b.ISBN, br.borDate, br.retDate, br.realRetDate, CASE WHEN br.retStatus = '未归还' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status, br.retStatus AS retStatusText, COALESCE(br.fineMoney, 0) AS fineAmount FROM borrowrec br JOIN bookcopy bc ON br.barCode = bc.barCode JOIN book b ON bc.ISBN = b.ISBN WHERE br.sno = #{sno} ORDER BY br.borDate DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrowrec WHERE retStatus = '未归还'

SELECT s.sno, s.username AS studentName, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrowrec br JOIN student s ON br.sno = s.sno WHERE YEAR(br.borDate) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(br.borDate) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY s.sno, s.username ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT b.ISBN, b.bname AS bookName, b.author, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount FROM borrowrec br JOIN bookcopy bc ON br.barCode = bc.barCode JOIN book b ON bc.ISBN = b.ISBN WHERE YEAR(br.borDate) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(br.borDate) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY b.ISBN, b.bname, b.author ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 10
